headline: Israeli bulldozers demolished a three-storey building in Hebron (families given five minutes)
dek: Israel has imposed a full closure of the occupied West Bank after the Hebron checkpoint shooting: nearly 1,000 checkpoints and gates closed, affecting millions. Israeli bulldozers demolished a three-storey building in Hebron; families were given five minutes to collect belongings.
sources: Al Jazeera liveblog (Nour Odeh report, Hebron)
fault_line: Security vs collective punishment: lockdown defenders vs those arguing 1,000 closed gates will radicalize the next generation.

sections.what_happened: Israel has imposed a full closure of the occupied West Bank after the Hebron checkpoint shooting: nearly 1,000 checkpoints and gates closed, affecting millions. Israeli bulldozers demolished a three-storey building in Hebron; families were given five minutes to collect belongings. Mustafa Barghouti: the closure turns every city and village into 'a small prison' and collective punishment 'will lead to explosions'.
sections.what_verified: Single family observed in-window (Al Jazeera liveblog); consistent with the previously recorded Netanyahu lockdown/operation orders (totw-20261023-1400-01 through 2100-02).
sections.what_disputed: Israel's military says it killed two Palestinian suspects; no second-family confirmation of the building demolition or the '1,000 checkpoints' figure.
sections.why_matters: 1,000 gates shut, one building flattened in Hebron, three days before Israelis vote.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to totw-20261023-1400-01 -- Israel's full West Bank closure now imposed: ~1,000 checkpoints and gates closed, millions affected; Israeli bulldozers demolished a three-storey building in Hebron (families given five minutes); Netanyahu's 'very extensive' operation order stands ahead of the Oct 27 elections

totw_analysis: Our read: 1,000 gates shut, one building flattened in Hebron, three days before Israelis vote. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Security vs collective punishment: lockdown defenders vs those arguing 1,000 closed gates will radicalize the next generation.
